transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hi, thank you. Um, well, I came in today because I keep getting these really nagging thoughts. I'm a designer, and lately I just keep worrying that I’ve missed some tiny mistake in a layout, or maybe I sent the wrong version of a file to a client. And the frustrating part is, even when I check and I can see it’s probably fine, my mind just keeps circling back to it anyway. It just won't let it go.
Aside from your work, do you find yourself constantly worrying about other everyday areas of your life, such as family, health, or finances?

No, not really. It's pretty much just focused on my work. I don't really worry about my health or money or anything like that more than a normal person would. It's just... the design files and the layouts. That's where I get stuck.
When you have these thoughts, do you find yourself repeatedly checking your work over and over again to try to relieve the anxiety?

Yeah, I do. Um, before I submit any work now, I'll usually go back and re-open the file. I'll compare the layers, re-save it, and... sometimes I just sit there and mentally walk through every single design choice one more time. It doesn't take over my whole day or anything, but it definitely makes me a lot slower. And it just makes me feel less free creatively when I'm having to do all that extra checking.
Deep down, do you view this repetitive checking as excessive and senseless, or does it feel like a necessary way to maintain your standards?

Um, I'm not really sure, to be honest. I guess I haven't thought about it quite like that. I mean, part of me feels like it's just a way to make sure the work is perfect and maintain my standards, but... I don't know. I really couldn't say if it's completely senseless or not. I'm just not sure.
Outside of your design work, would you say you are generally very rigid about rules, orderliness, and having things done your exact way?

No, not really. Outside of work, I'm actually pretty laid back. I mean, my house isn't perfectly spotless, and I don't really have a strict schedule or anything. I don't get upset if someone does something differently than how I'd do it at home. It's really just the design files where I get so caught up in the details.
